description: bits-ui's Command compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified command, input-group and input wrappers and the command-demo (a search input over two headed groups of items, one disabled, with shortcuts). The first item selected at mount; the input focused by a press; arrow keys moving the selection past the disabled item (not looping); the pointer over an item selecting it; End and Home; a press on an item selecting it; typing a query that only narrows ("s", "se", "set"): the list remounted by its key block, items filtered by bits-ui's fuzzy score and reordered by appendChild, the separator and an emptied group hidden, the first match selected; arrow keys and Enter in the filtered list. data-selected, data-value written by script, aria-activedescendant, the style-vega styles. Clearing the search or a query without matches is not covered (the framework would insert into children script reordered, reported unsupported)
